visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty: in a bottle (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js beach with sea, waves and foam, box-built character, email / compressor / free-app export / chat / drop zone / approved card / revision thread pages, a thrown bottle, a floppy disk, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.5 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: the video is done and now he has to send it. File too large, so he compresses it into a mosaic; the free app puts a watermark on his face; the brand cannot open the link; so it goes on a USB stick, in a bottle. Then YourBrand: drop the file in the app, posted exactly as uploaded (the original, no watermark), changes in one thread with Resubmit. The bottle came back with their notes on a floppy disk.
